answer.text:
According to Utz Brands, Inc.'s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 (Item 7, Results of Operations), the figures are as follows:

- **Income from operations:** $58,906 thousand (or $58.906 million)
- **Net sales:** $1,409,281 thousand (or $1,409.281 million; also discussed in the text as $1,409.3 million)

### **Calculation**
$$\text{Operating Income Margin} = \frac{\text{Income from operations}}{\text{Net sales}} = \frac{\$58,906}{\$1,409,281} \approx 4.180\%$$

*(Using the rounded figures from the text: $\frac{\$58.9 \text{ million}}{\$1,409.3 \text{ million}} \approx 4.179\%$)*

Utz Brands, Inc.'s operating income margin percentage for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024, was approximately **4.18%**.

*(Source: Utz Brands, Inc., Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024, Accession: 0001739566-25-000053, Item 7, Chunk ID: `14e6d7a8-d96c-5bc1-a7d5-febc26908e92`)*
